name: The Resilient Soul
niche: Stoic philosophy, resilience and emotional healing

voice.name: Frederick Surrey

visual_style: cinematic, moody natural light, muted warm palette with gold accents, marble statues, ancient ruins, lone figures in vast landscapes, rain and sea, 16:9, no text, no logos

music_prompt: slow ambient cinematic bed, soft piano and warm strings, 60-70 bpm, no drums, no vocals, gentle and hopeful, mixed quiet and dry to sit under a spoken voiceover, seamless loop feel

cta: If this helped, subscribe for a new lesson in resilience every week, and tell me in the comments which idea you'll practice first.
